data.title: Compare Objects: Deciding which of two objects is longer
data.description: Compare and measure real-world objects by their attributes

challenges.instruction: How many paper clips long is the pencil?
challenges.hint: Count each paper clip carefully from left to right along the pencil.

challenges.instruction: How many cubes long is the book?
challenges.hint: Line up your counting and count every single cube under the book.

challenges.instruction: How many crayons long is the ribbon?
challenges.hint: Count each crayon placed end to end below the ribbon.

challenges.instruction: How many erasers long is the shoe?
challenges.hint: Count the erasers one by one from start to finish.

challenges.instruction: How many blocks long is the ruler?
challenges.hint: Touch each block as you count to find the total length.

challenges.instruction: How many buttons long is the spoon?
challenges.hint: Count the buttons carefully from the top to the bottom of the spoon.

challenges.instruction: How many paper clips long is the marker?
challenges.hint: Count all the paper clips laid out under the marker.
